Through this endpoint you can submit feedback to a project with following data (all of the fields are optional):

- Visitor:
Email of the person the feedback is from

- Comment:
A text value

- Assignee:
ID of the assigned user (available through request to assignees endpoint) or email.
If not passed, the default assignee will be used. If null value is passed, the feedback will not be assigned to anyone.
